criterion: A test fails if the check reverts to comparing against verified only
summary: scripts/mutation_audit.py declares guard 'next action: a settled dependency is not pending', which reverts graph.py:1012 to '!= "verified"' in a copy of the tree and runs tests.test_graph_contract there.
